name: In Favor of Spirituality
summary: In the Valley of Trials, young Darkspear priests begin their lives beyond the training grounds. Under Ken'jai's direction, they travel to Tai'jin in Razor Hill and meet Durotar's wider challenges. Their path holds both ancestral troll ways and service in the Horde.

sections.title: Leaving the Red Canyon
sections.body: Darkspear acolytes leave the Valley of Trials after learning their basic rites from Ken'jai. The road from those secluded grounds leads to Razor Hill, a crossroads settlement in Durotar. There, a young priest steps beyond survival drills and begins to shoulder the spiritual and cultural duties of the tribe.

sections.title: Old Faiths and New Alliances
sections.body:
Ken'jai speaks plainly about the Darkspear's place in Thrall's Horde. The trolls value the orcs' loyalty and lessons of honor, though some ancestral traditions sit uneasily among their allies. So Darkspear spiritual leaders teach their pupils to preserve their heritage quietly while serving the Horde.

At Razor Hill, Tai'jin welcomes the acolytes. He guides them toward self-sufficiency and strength within the community.

faq.q: Who gives the quest In Favor of Spirituality?
aliases: who starts in favor of spirituality
quest giver in favor of spirituality
faq.answer: Ken'jai, the troll priest trainer in the Den, directs you from the Valley of Trials.
Tai'jin is in the barracks at Razor Hill, east of the town center along Durotar's main road.

faq.q: What classes can accept this quest?
aliases: who can take in favor of spirituality
faq.answer: Only troll priests beginning their journey in Durotar can take this path.

faq.q: Why does Ken'jai emphasize keeping some traditions secret?
faq.answer: Ken'jai says the orcs are loyal allies who value honor, but do not welcome every ancient troll ritual or custom. He teaches young priests to honor their ancestral heritage discreetly and preserve harmony within the Horde.

faq.q: What does Tai'jin teach the young priest upon arrival?
faq.answer: Tai'jin teaches that the Darkspear grew stronger by adapting to life in the Horde. The tribe prepares beforehand and enters battle already empowered, rather than waiting to draw strength directly from fallen foes.

faq.q: What quest immediately follows In Favor of Spirituality?
aliases: what comes after in favor of spirituality
in favor of spirituality follow up
faq.answer: After you report to Tai'jin, she offers Garments of Spirituality. You go to help a wounded Horde soldier in the field.

angles.text: As a priest, you leave the novice canyon and receive formal training and vestments from Tai'jin in Razor Hill.
As a troll, you balance loyalty to the Horde with the preservation of ancient tribal spirituality.
As a member of the Horde, you see diverse cultures work together in Durotar, joining the wild traditions of the Echo Isles with Razor Hill's martial outpost.
